long_biography.plain_text:
Arriving in Canada from Iran at 15, Michael Latifi carried a Farsi-English dictionary and combined study with three jobs. He tutored classmates in mathematics in exchange for help with English, then trained as an electrical engineer before completing an MBA part-time while working.

Latifi chose manufacturing and food processing after graduation, spending six years in the dairy sector before setting out on his own. That technical and commercial grounding shaped Sofina Foods, the private group he still leads. Its operations now span Canada, the United Kingdom and continental Europe, while the Sofina Foundation supports children's charities.

Its operations now span Canada, the United Kingdom and continental Europe, while the Sofina Foundation supports children's charities.
